name: El Campello (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of El Campello (a crowned shield with the Senyera above a tree and waves).
history: Municipal flag of El Campello; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Campello arms — Senyera, tree and waves
